name: Antimagic Field
description: A sphere of dead magic moves with you: spells fail inside it, magic items go mundane, summoned creatures wink out, and magical effects are suppressed at its border. Only artifacts and the works of deities resist its hush.

name: Antipathy/Sympathy
description: You enchant an object or area to repel or lure a kind of creature you name. Antipathy fills such creatures with terror that drives them away; Sympathy draws them irresistibly toward the target, held by fascination while within its aura, each resisted by a Wisdom save.

name: Clone
description: From a cubic inch of the subject's flesh you grow an inert duplicate body in a sealed vessel over 120 days. If the original dies while the clone is mature, its soul transfers into the clone and wakes in the new body — even, if you wish, a younger one.

name: Control Weather
description: You seize the sky for miles around, dictating precipitation, temperature, and wind — summoning storms, blizzards, or clear calm — shifting each condition gradually over the hours while you hold the working outdoors.

name: Demiplane
description: A shadowy door opens onto a demiplane of your own making, a room 30 feet in every dimension built of wood or stone as you please. When the spell ends, creatures still inside are trapped unless they can travel the planes — but you can reconnect to any demiplane you know of.

name: Dominate Monster
description: You seize the will of any creature, not just a humanoid, bending it to your telepathic commands on a failed Wisdom save. It obeys as fully as it can, repeating the save whenever it takes damage, and you may seize total, precise control with your action.

name: Earthquake
description: The earth shakes, rips, and convulses across a 100-foot circle: creatures are knocked prone on a failed Dexterity save, concentration falters, 1d6 fissures (each 1d10 × 10 feet deep) yawn open, and structures crumble under 50 points of bludgeoning damage each round until the ground settles — a structure that collapses can deal 12d6 bludgeoning damage to creatures near it.

name: Glibness
description: Your words gain an enchanted silver: for an hour, any Charisma check you roll below 15 counts as 15, and magic that would detect your lies cannot tell truth from falsehood — you simply decide what it reports.

name: Holy Aura
description: Divine light washes over you and allies within 30 feet, granting advantage on saving throws and making attackers roll at disadvantage. When a fiend or undead strikes one of the warded with a melee attack, the light flares — it must make a Constitution save or be blinded until the spell ends.

name: Incendiary Cloud
description: A roiling cloud of smoke and white-hot embers, 20 feet across, billows into being and drifts away from you as you direct. Creatures entering it or ending their turn inside take 10d8 fire damage on a failed Dexterity save, or half on a success, and its smoke heavily obscures the area.

name: Maze
description: You banish a creature into a labyrinthine demiplane of twisting corridors with no save to resist. Each turn it can spend its action trying to escape with a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check; when the spell ends, the victim pops back to where it vanished.

name: Mind Blank
description: One creature's mind becomes an unreadable fortress for a day: immune to psychic damage, mind reading, divination, and the charmed condition — proof even against Wish used to pry at its thoughts.

name: Power Word Stun
description: A word of power overwhelms the mind of a creature with 150 hit points or fewer, stunning it outright with no saving throw. At the end of each of its turns it makes a Constitution save to shake off the stun.

name: Sunburst
description: Brilliant sunlight explodes across a 60-foot sphere. Every creature in it takes 12d6 radiant damage on a failed Constitution save (half on a success) and is blinded for a minute unless it saves at the end of its turns; oozes and undead save at disadvantage, and all magical darkness in the area is dispelled.

name: Telepathy
description: You open a silent mental channel to any creature you know of, anywhere on the same plane, for a full day. Neither of you needs a shared language; the conversation is as private and effortless as thought itself.

name: Tsunami
description: A wall of water up to 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and 50 feet thick surges up at a point you choose within range. Each creature in its area when it appears makes a Strength save, taking 6d10 bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success. At the start of each of your turns after that, the wall and everything in it moves 50 feet away from you, and any Huge or smaller creature inside it or in a space it enters must succeed on a Strength save or take 5d10 bludgeoning damage (no more than once per round). At the end of each such turn the wall loses 50 feet of height and its later damage drops by 1d10; at 0 feet the spell ends. A creature caught in the wall can swim, but the wave's force means it must succeed on a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC to move at all, and a creature that leaves the wall falls to the ground.
